lines: 저는 프랑스 사람이에요.
Je suis français.
I'm French.
리옹에 살아요.
J'habite à Lyon.
I live in Lyon.
아침 일곱 시에 일어나요.
Je me lève à sept heures du matin.
I get up at seven in the morning.
커피를 마시고 회사에 가요.
Je bois un café et je vais au travail.
I drink a coffee and go to work.
회사는 집에서 가까워요.
Mon bureau est près de chez moi.
My office is close to home.
점심에는 동료하고 같이 밥을 먹어요.
Le midi, je mange avec un collègue.
At lunch I eat with a colleague.
저녁에는 집에서 한국어를 공부해요.
Le soir, j'étudie le coréen à la maison.
In the evening I study Korean at home.
한국어는 어렵지만 재미있어요.
Le coréen est difficile mais intéressant.
Korean is difficult but fun.
밤 열한 시에 자요.
Je me couche à onze heures du soir.
I go to bed at eleven at night.
주말에 시장에 갔어요.
Ce week-end, je suis allé au marché.
I went to the market at the weekend.
과일 가게에 사과하고 귤이 있었어요.
Chez le marchand de fruits, il y avait des pommes et des mandarines.
The fruit shop had apples and tangerines.
"사과 얼마예요?"
« Combien coûtent les pommes ? »
"How much are the apples?"
"세 개에 삼천 원이에요."
« Trois mille wons les trois. »
"Three thousand won for three."
"그럼 사과 세 개하고 귤 한 봉지 주세요."
« Alors trois pommes et un sachet de mandarines, s'il vous plaît. »
"Then three apples and a bag of tangerines, please."
"모두 팔천 원입니다."
« Ça fait huit mille wons en tout. »
"That's eight thousand won altogether."
과일이 아주 싸고 맛있었어요.
Les fruits étaient très bon marché et délicieux.
The fruit was very cheap and tasty.
다음 주에도 또 갈 거예요.
J'y retournerai la semaine prochaine.
I'll go again next week.
우리 가족은 네 명이에요.
Nous sommes quatre dans ma famille.
There are four people in my family.
아버지, 어머니, 누나, 그리고 저예요.
Mon père, ma mère, ma grande sœur et moi.
My father, my mother, my older sister and me.
부모님은 시골에 사세요.
Mes parents vivent à la campagne.
My parents live in the countryside.
집 앞에 작은 산이 있어요.
Il y a une petite montagne devant la maison.
There is a small mountain in front of the house.
누나는 의사예요. 병원에서 일해요.
Ma sœur est médecin. Elle travaille à l'hôpital.
My sister is a doctor. She works at a hospital.
저는 회사원이에요.
Moi, je suis employé de bureau.
I'm an office worker.
주말마다 가족하고 전화해요.
Chaque week-end, je téléphone à ma famille.
Every weekend I call my family.
가족이 보고 싶어요.
Ma famille me manque.
I miss my family.
토요일 아침에 눈을 떴는데 비가 오고 있었어요.
Samedi matin, quand j'ai ouvert les yeux, il pleuvait.
When I opened my eyes on Saturday morning, it was raining.
친구하고 등산을 가기로 했지만 날씨 때문에 못 갔어요.
J'avais prévu d'aller randonner avec un ami, mais on n'a pas pu à cause du temps.
I had planned to go hiking with a friend, but we couldn't because of the weather.
그래서 친구한테 전화해서 약속을 바꿨어요.
Alors j'ai appelé mon ami et on a changé nos plans.
So I called my friend and we changed our plans.
우리는 산 대신 영화관에 가기로 했어요.
On a décidé d'aller au cinéma plutôt qu'à la montagne.
We decided to go to the cinema instead of the mountain.
영화를 보기 전에 근처 식당에서 칼국수를 먹었어요.
Avant le film, on a mangé des kalguksu dans un restaurant du coin.
Before the film we ate kalguksu at a nearby restaurant.
비 오는 날에는 따뜻한 국물이 정말 맛있어요.
Les jours de pluie, un bouillon chaud est vraiment délicieux.
On rainy days, warm broth is really delicious.
영화는 생각보다 재미있어서 시간이 빨리 지나갔어요.
Le film était mieux que prévu, alors le temps est passé vite.
The film was more fun than expected, so time flew by.
집에 돌아올 때는 비가 그치고 하늘이 맑아졌어요.
Quand je suis rentré, la pluie s'était arrêtée et le ciel s'était dégagé.
By the time I came home, the rain had stopped and the sky had cleared.
등산은 못 했지만 기분 좋은 하루였어요.
Je n'ai pas pu randonner, mais c'était une bonne journée.
I couldn't go hiking, but it was a pleasant day.
저는 작년 여름에 처음 한국에 갔어요.
Je suis allé en Corée pour la première fois l'été dernier.
I went to Korea for the first time last summer.
공항에 도착했을 때 너무 덥고 습해서 깜짝 놀랐어요.
En arrivant à l'aéroport, j'ai été surpris par la chaleur et l'humidité.
When I arrived at the airport, I was startled by how hot and humid it was.
지하철을 타고 숙소에 가려고 했는데 노선이 복잡해서 길을 잃었어요.
Je voulais prendre le métro jusqu'à mon logement, mais les lignes étaient compliquées et je me suis perdu.
I meant to take the subway to my accommodation, but the lines were complicated and I got lost.
그때 옆에 있던 아주머니가 친절하게 도와주셨어요.
À ce moment-là, une dame à côté de moi m'a gentiment aidé.
Just then, a lady next to me kindly helped me.
한국어를 잘 못했지만 천천히 말하니까 이해할 수 있었어요.
Je parlais mal coréen, mais en parlant lentement, on a pu se comprendre.
My Korean wasn't good, but by speaking slowly we could understand each other.
숙소에 도착한 후에 편의점에서 삼각김밥을 사 먹었어요.
Une fois arrivé, j'ai acheté un samgak-gimbap à la supérette.
After reaching my accommodation, I bought a triangle gimbap at the convenience store.
싸고 맛있어서 그 후에도 자주 먹게 됐어요.
C'était bon et pas cher, alors j'en ai souvent mangé par la suite.
It was cheap and tasty, so I ended up eating it often afterwards.
그날부터 한국어를 더 열심히 공부하기로 했어요.
À partir de ce jour, j'ai décidé d'étudier le coréen plus sérieusement.
From that day on, I decided to study Korean harder.
지난달에 회사 근처에 있는 원룸으로 이사를 했어요.
Le mois dernier, j'ai emménagé dans un studio près de mon bureau.
Last month I moved into a studio near my office.
전에 살던 집은 방음이 잘 안 돼서 밤마다 옆집 소리 때문에 잠을 못 잤거든요.
Mon ancien logement était mal insonorisé, et le bruit des voisins m'empêchait de dormir toutes les nuits.
My old place was badly soundproofed, and the neighbours' noise kept me awake every night.
집을 구하는 것은 생각보다 쉽지 않았어요.
Trouver un logement n'a pas été aussi facile que je le pensais.
Finding a place wasn't as easy as I'd thought.
월세가 저렴하면 회사에서 멀고, 가까우면 보증금이 너무 비쌌어요.
Quand le loyer était bas, c'était loin du bureau ; quand c'était près, la caution était trop chère.
If the rent was low it was far from work, and if it was close the deposit was too expensive.
부동산을 다섯 군데나 돌아다닌 끝에 마음에 드는 집을 찾았어요.
Après avoir fait pas moins de cinq agences, j'ai trouvé un logement qui me plaisait.
After going round no fewer than five estate agents, I found a place I liked.
이사하는 날에는 짐을 옮기는 데다가 청소까지 해야 해서 정신이 없었어요.
Le jour du déménagement, entre les cartons à porter et le ménage en plus, je ne savais plus où donner de la tête.
On moving day, with boxes to carry and cleaning on top of that, I was run off my feet.
친구들이 도와준 덕분에 저녁 전에 다 끝낼 수 있었어요.
Grâce à l'aide de mes amis, on a pu tout finir avant le soir.
Thanks to my friends' help, we finished everything before evening.
고마운 마음에 제가 저녁을 샀는데, 다들 맛있게 먹는 걸 보니까 뿌듯했어요.
Pour les remercier, je leur ai offert le dîner, et les voir se régaler m'a fait chaud au cœur.
To thank them I bought dinner, and seeing everyone enjoy it made me feel proud.
아직 커튼도 못 달았지만 조용한 집에서 푹 잘 수 있어서 행복해요.
Je n'ai même pas encore posé les rideaux, mais je suis heureux de dormir profondément dans un logement calme.
I haven't even hung the curtains yet, but I'm happy to sleep soundly in a quiet home.

t: Le métro qui s'arrête le samedi
lines: 요즘 리옹에서는 토요일마다 시위가 있어요.
Ces temps-ci, il y a des manifestations tous les samedis à Lyon.
These days there are protests in Lyon every Saturday.
시위가 있는 날에는 지하철이 멈추는 데다가 버스까지 늦게 와요.
Les jours de manifestation, le métro s'arrête et, en plus, même les bus sont en retard.
On protest days the subway stops and, on top of that, even the buses run late.
처음에는 짜증이 났지만 요즘은 그냥 걸어 다니기로 했어요.
Au début ça m'agaçait, mais maintenant j'ai décidé de me déplacer à pied.
At first it annoyed me, but now I've decided to just get around on foot.
막상 걸어 보니까 생각보다 멀지 않았어요.
En essayant vraiment, je me suis rendu compte que ce n'était pas si loin.
Once I actually tried walking, it wasn't as far as I'd thought.
걷는 동안 한국어 팟캐스트를 들을 수 있어서 오히려 좋은 점도 있어요.
Comme je peux écouter des podcasts en coréen en marchant, ça a même des avantages.
Since I can listen to Korean podcasts while I walk, there are actually upsides.
지난주에는 걷다가 우연히 예쁜 카페를 발견했어요.
La semaine dernière, en marchant, j'ai découvert par hasard un joli café.
Last week, while walking, I stumbled on a pretty café.
거기에서 커피를 한잔하면서 일기를 썼는데 기분 전환이 됐어요.
J'y ai écrit mon journal autour d'un café, et ça m'a changé les idées.
I wrote my diary there over a coffee, and it lifted my mood.
불편한 일도 생각하기에 따라 다르게 느껴진다는 걸 알게 됐어요.
J'ai compris que même un désagrément se vit différemment selon la façon dont on le prend.
I realised that even an inconvenience feels different depending on how you look at it.
그래도 다음 토요일에는 지하철이 다니면 좋겠어요.
N'empêche, j'aimerais bien que le métro circule samedi prochain.
Even so, I hope the subway is running next Saturday.
